titulo: Doctor warned Elizabeth Struhs would not be safe years before sect killed her by withdrawing medicine
cuerpo: Inquest hears paediatricians pleaded with child safety for action to protect the eight-year-old from her parents and other Toowoomba sect members Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A specialist child safety doctor was “stonewalled” by a child safety officer after repeatedly warning that Elizabeth Struhs would not be safe living with her mother, years before her parents allowed her to die by withdrawing lifesaving medicine, a coronial inquest has heard. Elizabeth returned to live with her parents at her family home in Toowoomba in 2019, after both of them were convicted of neglecting her. Continue reading...
